text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the correct Islamic aqeedah (creed) and noble akhlaq (character) from a young age. Among the rights of children upon their parents is to raise them with sound imani (faith-based) tarbiyah (upbringing) and to instill the love of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ in their hearts. It is also important to plant religious values such as salah (prayer), truthfulness, and amanah (trustworthiness) in the souls of children.

review_defects.why: The English adds the honorific ﷺ after 'His Messenger', but the Arabic source does not include it. This is an addition not present in the original.
